Truth Social Faces Fines, Declining Traffic, and Criticism

Donald Trump's social media platform, Truth Social, is facing potential "mega-fines" under Australia's online safety laws, according to reports. The platform has also seen a sharp decline in traffic. Separately, director Danny Boyle has criticized Truth Social, calling its content "lies."
